== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Leave Them To Me (V) (Death Star II) (Errata 2)]] (<code>2261_2024</code>, Virtual Shields D17), showing the '''PC-E2''' game text. Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text. “Subjugated Planet” with a capital P.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VShieldsType), as captured https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064820/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VShieldsType.html
* '''PC-E2 text:''' “Plays on table. At opponent's Dantooine and Subjugated Planet sites, your Imperials are deploy -2 and your Force drains may not be modified or canceled by opponent. Your game text at opponent's <>Swamp and <>Jungle is canceled. Your characters present at opponent's <>Forest are immune to attrition.”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card, with the PC-E2 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-23-Leave_Them_To_Me_Death_Star_II-PC-E2-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B41 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
